# GOEXPERIMENT=arm64e does not support the race detector or plugins.

[!GOOS:darwin] skip
[!GOARCH:arm64] skip
[!cgo] skip

env GOEXPERIMENT=arm64e

! go build -race .
stderr '^-race is not supported with GOEXPERIMENT=arm64e$'

! go build -buildmode=plugin .
stderr '^-buildmode=plugin not supported with GOEXPERIMENT=arm64e$'

-- go.mod --
module m

go 1.26
-- main.go --
package main

func main() {}
